text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day off, while strolling through town—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer.
Are you out for a walk?
choice_data_list: Yeah, just wandering around. What about you?
Yeah, just wandering around. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I was conducting my Holy Maiden training♪
I thought I would study up on "that realm."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There is an art exhibition themed around medieval life.
I go there to let my thoughts wander to daily life in "that realm."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
According to the story that granted me divine revelation as a child—
it is highly likely that life in "that realm" resembles medieval times.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I know!
If you'd like, would you care to join me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The people of "that realm" must surely wear ornaments like these...
...My, look at this painting! Behold, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Could it be depicting a festival in a village from those times?
I can almost hear the jaunty music playing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I can picture it so clearly. Bards singing in the plaza,
wooden tankards clinking in toasts all around—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That lively bustle is a humble hymn to the footsteps of everyday life—
As the Holy Maiden, I shall offer a prayer to their feast.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"May a single drop of blessing be upon this life..."
Praying thus, I would return a gentle smile to them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Fufu, I still have much to learn.
For the day I finally journey to "that realm"—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, this floor...!
Could it be modeled after a medieval castle?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Holding a grand ball in a place like this is a classic staple of isekai novels!
One day, I too shall wear a gown and make my high society debut in that other world...♪

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Are you interested in dresses? As part of our special exhibit,
you can try on attire styled after medieval nobility if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whaaaat, really?!
—T-Trainer!
choice_data_list: Go ahead, you should definitely try it on.
Go ahead, you should definitely try it on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by the staff, Red Desire heads excitedly to the dressing room.
Seeing her so thrilled makes me want to give her an even better experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything I can do to make this more special?
As I ponder this while looking over the exhibition flyer—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for waiting.
Um... how do I look...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Actually wearing it makes me a little nervous.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Still—yes. Even if I were invited to a ball in "that realm,"
I feel like I could dance properly now. Fufu... I think I've gained some confidence.
choice_data_list: In that case, want to try dancing right now?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...How wonderful...!
It's just like the ballroom in the book illustrations...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Um, is it truly all right for us to dance here?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I checked with the staff.
Yeah, I made sure to check.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In addition to costume rentals,
this hall was opened up for visitors to take photos and videos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dancing was completely fine as long as we didn't get in anyone else's way.
I drop to one knee before the bewildered girl and extend a hand.
choice_data_list: May I have this dance, Holy Maiden?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
............!
—Yes. With pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us imagine a minuet.
Match your rhythm with mine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Gracefully—and lightly—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you are quite skilled.
Just like this, the two of us, blooming like flowers in the hall—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
One... two, three.
Two, two, three.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping quietly together in the corner of the hall,
I start to feel as though elegant music is truly echoing in the air...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...How wondrous.
It is as though the dreams in my heart are bursting into vivid color.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Dancing like this, in this world.
The sights I wished for are taking shape, little by little.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...You truly are a wondrous person, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
On the day we formed our contract, too.
You prepared such a magnificent stage just for me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And now, in this very moment.
You make my heart dance with joy—...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I'm nothing special."
You said those words before, but—... I say otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The way you dedicate yourself to bringing joy to others.
You are—truly a "noble" soul.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CHIME... CHIME...)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The museum will be closing soon.
There are currently 30 minutes remaining until closing time."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... It is time for it to end already.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...I must change out of this gown.
Come, shall we go, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for keeping me company today.
Thanks to you, I spent a truly delightful time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It really is—... wonderful, isn't it?
To let our thoughts wander together toward "that realm"...
choice_data_list: I had a great time too. So—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list: Invite me again next time you study up on the other world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (...The sunset is so beautiful.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since I met this person, this world...
feels so much more colorful than before.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Such joyful colors............
............Yet the brighter the colors become, the deeper inside—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The distant other world... I will not ask you to "come with me."
When the time comes, please simply send me off with your blessings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (I am... the Holy Maiden of that distant realm...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Precisely because today was so wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The "shadow"... falls all the darker.
